subject: Mutual Action Plan: POC bridge & fallback activation cadence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@evergreenhealth.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: POC bridge & fallback activation cadence

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Based on the scope we discussed (sandbox inference for triage workflows + embeddings for search), I drafted a short mutual action plan and a practical activation cadence so we can get a gated POC running within 3 weeks. The attached PDF is a single-sheet MAP that lists owner by task, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. High-level items we need to align on now:

- Org setup and IAM: Evergreen will create a service account for the POC; Redwood will provide an onboarding script for org membership.
- API keys: Redwood issues scoped keys for the sandbox project (token rotation policy noted).
- IP allowlist: Evergreen to provide public egress IPs; we will pre-seed allowlist entries and validate connectivity.
- VPC peering: optional for performance — schedule network kickoff with infra contacts if Evergreen wants peering during evaluation.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm owners for "org setup" and "network" by EOD Friday.
2) We provision a sandbox API key and a test endpoint the following Monday.
3) If peering is required, we run a short preflight with your cloud team and our marketplace partner (cc'd).

Attaching: Evergreen_MAP_POC_20250611.pdf (MAP), network-allowlist-evergreen-template.csv, and a short playbook.

If that plan looks good I can convert it to a HubSpot plan and share the ticket for sign-off.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0184

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@evergreenhealth.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-11T12:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: POC bridge & fallback activation cadence

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear plan and the one-pager. Quick answers:
- Org owner: me (Lydia Park) — I will create the service account and grant the sandbox project owner-level access for the POC week.
- Network owner: Jake Morales (cc'd at pilotops@evergreenhealth.io) will handle IP details and peering feasibility.

Two clarifications from our side before we lock dates:
1) For API keys, can the scoped key be restricted to only the inference endpoints and set to expire in 30 days? We need token rotation to be enforced by default.
2) For VPC peering, we are on AWS and are concerned about route table complexity — if peering is optional, we prefer an initial run without peering and fallback to peering only if latency/bandwidth constraints appear.

I'll loop in Jake for the network CSV and to confirm the public egress IP ranges. Looking forward to the Monday test endpoint.

Best,
Lydia Park
Senior Product Manager, Evergreen Health
lydia.park@evergreenhealth.io

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@evergreenhealth.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, pilotops@evergreenhealth.io
Date: 2025-06-12T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: POC bridge & fallback activation cadence

Great — thanks Lydia. Short replies inline: 

- Scoped key + 30-day expiry: yes. We'll issue a key scoped to the inference API and embeddings only; rotation policy will be set to 30 days and we provide a one-click rotation flow in the console.
- Peering: perfect — we will start with allowlist-only connectivity and measure tail latency. Peering is included as a fallback.

Ben (cc) will pick up the sandbox key provisioning and the initial test endpoint. Neha will own the security checklist and make sure the key policy meets your compliance bar.

Planned dates:
- Monday 2025-06-16: sandbox key + test endpoint delivered (Benjamin to confirm details).
- Wed 2025-06-18: first run of synthetic inference tests and simple embedding ingest.
- Tue 2025-06-24: decision window — continue with allowlist or trigger peering preflight (if we see >30ms median token latency in canonical test).

I'll convert the PDF into a HubSpot task list and send the link after Ben confirms.

— Jonas

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@evergreenhealth.io>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-12T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: POC bridge & fallback activation cadence

Morning team —

I will provision the sandbox project and create the scoped key today. Deliverables I will upload to the shared Drive:
- sandbox-endpoint.txt (endpoint URL + test token stub)
- curl-snippet.txt (example request for your engineers)
- traffic-patterns.json (suggested synthetic workloads) [attachment stub] 

Notes / constraints:
- The key will be scoped to inference + embeddings, and set to auto-expire in 30 days. If Evergreen wants HSM-backed keys later, we can switch after the POC.
- For IP allowlist, please provide the CSV with the egress ranges; I'll pre-seed our firewall and run a connectivity check from our side. If Jake sends ranges today I can do the preflight this afternoon.

Attaching: redwood-activation-playbook.md (short runbook).

— Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: pilotops@evergreenhealth.io <pilotops@evergreenhealth.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@evergreenhealth.io>
Date: 2025-06-12T11:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: POC bridge & fallback activation cadence

Folks —

Jake here (network ops). Attached is the CSV with the public egress IP ranges and the VPC CIDR we would consider for peering. For the initial run we are happy to start with allowlist-only.

Questions from our infra lead: how will NAT traversal be validated from Redwood side? We want to avoid accidental open routes. Also, if we later request peering, what is the expected downtime/risk window?

I included Marketplace Integrations (marketplace-accounts@amazon.com) because Evergreen will be procuring via the AWS Marketplace and they asked for a short network note for procurement.

Thanks — attaching: network-allowlist-evergreen-template.csv

— Jake Morales
Network Ops, Evergreen Health
pilotops@evergreenhealth.io

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@evergreenhealth.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-25T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: POC bridge & fallback activation cadence — final checklist & sign-off

Hi all —

Quick status and request for sign-off before we move into the execution window next week: 

Summary:
- Sandbox key issued (scoped, 30-day expiry) — delivery confirmed by Ben on 2025-06-16.
- IP allowlist validated — Redwood preflight succeeded against the CSV Jake provided on 2025-06-12.
- No peering performed yet; decision window set for 2025-06-24.

Security / compliance notes: 
- Key policy enforces inference-only scope and prohibits export in logs. We will keep access logs for 90 days by default and provide them to Evergreen on request during the POC (longer retention available as an add-on).
- Token rotation flow is enabled and we will rotate the scoped key at day 30 automatically.

Action: Please reply ALL with the single-line approval below so Marissa can close the HubSpot MAP: 

"I approve the Mutual Action Plan and consent to the sandbox activation as described (allowlist-only initial run)."

If you want peering during the POC, please state that explicitly — otherwise we will treat peering as a conditional follow-up. 

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor | Security & Compliance (Onboarding) | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
